name: Margo Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Margo Finance Ltd is in 
the business of investing in shares & securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Accepting Non-Banking Financial Company. It is engaged primarily in Investment activities, as financing activities were discontinued in FY21

pros: Stock is trading at 0.27 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 151 days to 59.5 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.01% over last 3 years.
